# RYZM

> RYZM is an English-language market framework site. It tracks rates, funding, FX, and credit, with Korea as the bridge between US liquidity and the global semiconductor cycle. RYZM publishes frameworks and sourced notes, not forecasts or trading signals.

- Home: https://ryzm.app/
- Articles (full text on this site): https://ryzm.app/articles/
- About: https://ryzm.app/about/
- Daily briefs (full text on this site): https://ryzm.app/notes/
- Blog with daily briefs and news notes: https://ryzm9.wordpress.com/
- Updated daily (Feed, Breaking, Articles, Notes). Every number links to its primary source.

## Active frameworks

- **Cash is a position:** Optionality has value. Forced binaries miss the third choice. Sitting is not losing when the risk premium is mispriced.
- **Liquidity plumbing:** RRP, TGA, QT, and reserves move before narrative. Track the mechanical drain.
- **Korea as canary:** Energy import dependent. Semiconductor cycle. Export data leads global industrial activity.
- **Credit leads equities:** Spreads and issuance change before multiples. When credit disagrees with the tape, credit is usually earlier.
